body.error: No coordinates in the database: every §8–§12 table is keyed by district municipality (no stations, boreholes, dams or sampling points with locations), so point layers cannot be drawn. Alert levels (spec §8.2: L1 < 50 %, L2 < 30 %, L3 < 15 % FSC) need valid storage. Storage Volume is withheld (8_1_reservoir_operational_master): 51 of 52 districts hold the same storage (251 997 542.57 m³ = 100 % FSC, level 1 200 m, 52.5 km² water area) on every day from January 2000 to October 2026; only Vhembe varies
